board.summary: Fresh discovery was completed from the configured Bad Left Hook homepage and current internal fight-week links before prior cards were reviewed. NEW TODAY: 2 selections — Ben Mahoney ML and Luka Plantic ML, both WATCH only at materially better prices. CARRIED FORWARD: 4 selections — Cameron ML, Cameron by Decision, Hrgovic ML and Berinchyk ML. No PLAY is live. Material new information changed existing candidates: Cameron's Aug. 25 fight-week interview strengthens the matchup thesis but +220 still misses the +240 ML entry; explicit full-method normalization puts Cameron by decision near +458 fair, so the prior +450 trigger is tightened to +500; and broad Aug. 25 expert support for Itauma plus a current Hrgovic no-vig level near +722 raises Hrgovic's useful trigger from +750 to +800. The prior Martinez KO/TKO WATCH is removed because no defensible current method quote was verified. Freshly discovered Mahoney has drifted from roughly +330 toward a best observed +455 but remains below a roughly +495 no-vig level, while Plantic's best observed price has improved toward +489 but clean three-way sportsbook pricing still normalizes near +504. Current-day-only display remains in force.
